readme_blocks: CAN and USB impedance/skew: analytical estimate only (`step6_reports.py`, [`../reports/verification-pcb/impedance.md`](../reports/verification-pcb/impedance.md): Hammerstad-Jensen / Kirschning-Jansen for the file stackup and for JLCPCB JLC7628; USB netclass 0.35/0.15 mm, CAN_DIFF 0.22/0.23 mm). KiCad's DRC does not check impedance; the stackup is assumed, not confirmed with the fabricator; no TDR. **Addressed by software, not physically verified**

`USB_D+/-`: rerouted as an edge-coupled pair on B.Cu with one symmetric via pair and 0.35/0.15 mm width/gap, skew < 0.3 mm ([`../reports/verification-pcb/usb-reroute.md`](../reports/verification-pcb/usb-reroute.md)); previously 2 vias per net on In1.Cu. USB FS 12 Mbit/s is tolerant either way. **Addressed by software, not physically verified**

DRC inherited from the OpenBlackPanda baseline: now lib_footprint_mismatch 73 ([`../reports/verification-pcb/drc-cleanup.md`](../reports/verification-pcb/drc-cleanup.md); `lib_footprint_mismatch` is intentional: local footprint edits). Clearance/unconnected/shorts/courtyards = 0/0/0/0. **Addressed by software, not physically verified**

Gerber review executed in software ([`../reports/verification-pcb/gerber-review.md`](../reports/verification-pcb/gerber-review.md)): 11 layers rendered to PNG (`../reports/verification-pcb/gerber-render/`), Edge.Cuts outline 51.02 x 46.75 mm vs PCB 51.02 x 46.75 mm, drill hits 268 vs PCB holes 268, copper connectivity rebuilt from the gerbers + drill and compared with the KiCad netlist: 0 short(s), 0 open(s) over 142 nets. **Addressed by software, not physically verified** A human look in KiCad GerbView is still part of the remaining checks below.

Via-in-pad: 0 (`final_audit.py` definition: via centre inside an SMD pad of another net or of a small pad); 9 same-net thermal vias inside exposed pads (U6 PowerPAD, U8-U11 DFN EP, placed by `vpcb_a10_thermal_vias.py`) are deliberate ([`../reports/verification-pcb/hand-assembly.md`](../reports/verification-pcb/hand-assembly.md)). **Addressed by software, not physically verified**

Hand-solder friendliness: solder mask minimum web 0.1 mm (`solder_mask_min_width`), mask slivers >= 0.2 mm between U7 LQFP-144 and P1 USB-C 0.5 mm pads, DFN pin-to-EP mask 0.13 mm, one 0.6/0.3 mm GND via in each DFN exposed pad, vias tented both sides; ENIG recommended ([`../reports/verification-pcb/hand-assembly.md`](../reports/verification-pcb/hand-assembly.md)). **Addressed by software, not physically verified**
